run_sweep_collect: run the sweep collect tool to gather and summarize results from a PyCLS hyperparameter sweep
run_load_data: run the load_data function to load and sort log data from a stdout.log file including stderr output
review_sweep_collect: review the sweep_collect function that collects sweep results, prints job status, and saves sweep.json
review_load_data: review the load_data function that loads log data, sorts it, and attaches stderr content
summarize_sweep_collect: summarize the sweep_collect function that aggregates sweep job logs, prints completion stats, and cleans up checkpoints
